# Diagnostics

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Run a ground wire, connect power, and check if the AC clutch engages when applied. [t286]

Identify the code as P0420, which indicates a Bank 1 issue. [t492]

[Partial] Inspect all three transfer case switches located inside the transmission housing, then disconnect each individually. [t672]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Run a ground wire from one bolt hole face on the compressor.
2. [Partial] Connect a +12v wire to the single-wire harness connector.
3. Check if the AC clutch engages when power is applied.
4. [Partial] Inspect the wiring running from the fuse box to the compressor.
5. Verify the signal path inside the cabin leading to the Body Control Module (BCM).
6. [Partial] Test the functionality of the AC refrigerant pressure sensor itself.
7. [Partial] Remove an ECU from a donor '04 Armada vehicle.
8. Install the borrowed ECU into the Minion truck's engine bay.
9. Request and obtain a new license key from UpRev for the swapped ECU.
10. [Partial] Upload the new tune file to transfer ownership of the license to the ECU.
11. Turn on the AC switch while the engine is running.
12. [Partial] Perform an alignment if steering angle lights remain illuminated after installation.
13. Purchase a $70 vacuum kit designed for cooling systems.
14. [Partial] Connect the vacuum pump to draw air out of the coolant system.
15. [Partial] Fill the radiator with fresh coolant until it begins sucking up from the reservoir.
16. [Partial] Allow the system to run and suck in remaining trapped air pockets.
17. Monitor engine temperature during off-roading while the AC is cranking.

_Procedure reported by [t286]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-vk-swap-with-auto-trans.8909/>_

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t672] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Inspect all three transfer case switches located inside the transmission housing.
2. Disconnect each switch individually to isolate potential faults.

</details>

## Tips & gotchas

- Use this method to test if the AC clutch engages without starting the engine. [t286]
- [Partial] If the clutch engages, the issue lies in the wiring path rather than the compressor itself. [t286]
- Note that the license for tuning software (UpRev) transfers to this new ECU upon first upload. [t286]
- To restore a lost license, flash the ECU back to stock ROM and request reissuance from UpRev. [t286]
- This method removes all air pockets that filling through the radiator and burping might miss. [t286]
- Ideal for systems where previous fill methods failed to eliminate trapped air. [t286]
- [Partial] This is often overlooked during initial troubleshooting of AC clutch issues. [t286]
- Verify the sensor before assuming it is an ECU failure. [t286]
- Look for trouble codes C1143 and C1163 on the dashboard. [t286]
- A recalibration or reset at a dealership may be required to clear these specific lights. [t286]
- [Partial] Expect temperatures hovering around 200°F under heavy load with AC on. [t286]
- Be prepared for the engine cover to be hot enough to burn skin. [t286]
- This breaker may pop under extreme heat conditions. [t286]
- Allow time for it to cool down before attempting to close or reset it again. [t286]
- Clean electrical contacts with electric parts cleaner if cleaning is needed. [t672]
- [Partial] Focus on the front-most switch as it is prone to cracking and splitting due to its spring-loaded design. [t672]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Assuming a broken switch will stay intact without inspecting closely for hairline cracks that split under pressure. [t672]
